log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Gengar

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Gengar + Aerodactyl lead again denies opponent's core setup: Mega Gengar's Shadow Tag traps key targets while Aerodactyl uses Tailwind or Taunt to control tempo and neutralize Follow Me. Gengar's Sludge Bomb heavily threatens Floette, while Aerodactyl's Sash guarantees speed control. In the back, Choice Scarf Krookodile and Multiscale Dragonite clean up trapped targets with High Horsepower, Knock Off, and Extreme Speed under Tailwind.

Intended Mega: Floette (delay Aura). Lead Pult+Maus: T1 FM+Scarf SB remove Gengar before TW/Mega Tag. Back Floette+Basc: chip DN Multiscale then Basc Adapt LR snowball; Floette mega closes. Avoids prior MegaFloette+Maus lead fail.

Choice Scarf Dragapult outspeeds Gengar (267-319 vs 178) and threatens a super-effective OHKO with Shadow Ball. Aerodactyl at 200 Speed outspeeds Maushold (max 179) and is guaranteed to set Tailwind before Maushold acts. Gengar using Protect + Mega Evolve completely safely blocks Dragapult while activating Shadow Tag and increasing Mega Gengar's base Speed. On Turn 2 under Tailwind, Mega Gengar (400 Speed) will outspeed Scarf Dragapult and lock in the KO with Shadow Ball.
decisions.notebook: Opponent specifics: Mega Floette (Light of Ruin, Fairy Aura), Maushold (Wide Lens, Follow Me), Dragapult (Choice Scarf), Basculegion (Adaptability). Game 1 win secured via lead pressure; Gengar Protect + Aerodactyl Tailwind establishes turn-2 outspeed on Scarf Dragapult.

decisions.rationale: Scarf Pult outspeeds; SB is best Gengar removal (67-129%) and locks acceptable Ghost spam. FM +2 beats Taunt and makes Ghost SB fizzle on Normal; accept Sludge risk on Maushold to keep Pult. Switches fail vs Mega Shadow Tag.

Dragapult is Scarf-locked into Shadow Ball. Rather than risk a 37.5% OHKO roll on Gengar-Mega through Friend Guard or Follow Me redirection, switching Gengar to Krookodile safely absorbs Shadow Ball for minor resistance damage while Intimidating Maushold. Aerodactyl's Rock Slide applies spread pressure to both targets under Tailwind.
Pult Scarf-locked SB; TW Gengar outspeeds and OHKOs Pult on SB. FM makes Ghost SB whiff; Sludge leaves Maus ~6-32% so Pult can fire 52-117% into Gengar. Must delete Mega before DN Multiscale.

Under Tailwind, Krookodile and Aerodactyl both outspeed the opposing board. Knock Off onto Dragapult guarantees a KO on turn 3 regardless of Maushold's action: if Maushold uses Follow Me, redirected Knock Off + Aerodactyl's Rock Slide KOes Maushold; if Maushold does not redirect, Knock Off KOes Dragapult through its Scarf. Lock into Dark STAB is also favorable vs opponent's remaining Ghost/Water threats.

Pult is Choice-locked SB and dies to Scarf Krook Knock under TW; hard switch Basc (Sitrus, takes Knock/HHP). Maus FM redirects singles so Basc enters cleanly; RS still spreads but Friend Guard helps. Preserve Pult/Floette for later Gengar/DN.
decisions.notebook: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate Krook, Empoleon, Clef Unaware. Gengar Timid mega SB/Sludge/WoW/Protect (aggressively sludges redirectors). Aero sash Pressure Jolly TW/RS/WG/Taunt. DN Adamant Multiscale Lum ES/Outrage/EQ/DD. Krook Scarf Jolly. Emp Modest Sitrus Competitive. Clef Bold Unaware FM/MB/HH/Protect. Floette mega+Maus FG/FM lead fails vs Gengar+Aero TW (recoil+chip, ES cleans). Need Ghost/Fighting + redirect; delay Fairy Aura mega; remove Gengar first then Multiscale chip for Basc LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged.

decisions.rationale: Krook locked Knock Off; bring Scarf Pult to threaten both, U-turn or Draco/SB after. Floette dies to RS/EQ later and delays mega. Basc Protects or Aqua Jets next. Need Ghost pressure vs Gengar/DN.

Registered sets unchanged. Pult Scarf Timid Infiltrator.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, Krookodile (474) and Aerodactyl (400) both outspeed Dragapult (267-319). Combining Krookodile's Knock Off (52.3-95.7%) with Aerodactyl's spread Rock Slide (20-38.7%) into Dragapult guarantees KOing Dragapult at 71% HP before it acts. Removing Dragapult eliminates their primary speed threat before Tailwind expires, leaving Basculegion weakened and easily managed by Gengar, Dragonite, and Aerodactyl.

TW ends after this turn. Krook locked Knock Off; Protect Basc dodges it and RS flinch/chip. Scarf Pult outspeeds post-TW but under TW Aero is faster—SB Aero breaks sash or forces WG. Live to remove TW then clean with LR/Aqua.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

In a 4v2 endgame, switching Krookodile to Gengar-Mega safely absorbs incoming Fairy/Water attacks while activating Shadow Tag to trap both remaining foes. Aerodactyl's high speed Rock Slide provides free spread chip and flinch pressure, guaranteeing Gengar outspeeds and cleans up with Sludge Bomb next turn.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Krookodile) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Krook Scarf-locked Knock; AJ priority KO range on 77% Ground after Intim. Mega LoR KOs Krook through sashless. Floette outspeeds Aero; Basc lives RS. Clear path to LR snowball vs remaining.

Gengar (200) and Aerodactyl (200) outspeed both trapped foes naturally under Shadow Tag. Basculegion poses the highest immediate threat with 150 BP Adaptability Last Respects. At 53% HP with base 75 SpD, Basculegion is comfortably KOed by Gengar's STAB 2x super-effective Shadow Ball plus spread Rock Slide. Aqua Jet from Basculegion cannot KO 59% Gengar. Removing Basculegion leaves Floette-Mega alone against four full-control attackers.

Switching in Krookodile immediately triggers Intimidate to drop Basculegion's Attack by 1 stage, neutering its Aqua Jet and Wave Crash damage. With Choice Scarf, Krookodile will outspeed both 53% Basculegion and 3% Floette-Mega on Turn 7 to secure the win alongside Aerodactyl.

decisions.rationale: Gengar SB guarantees KO Basc before LR/WC; must Protect. Floette LoR+Aura into 59% Gengar is best removal (Fairy resisted but strongest roll). WG misses singles; sash Aero less urgent than removing SB.

decisions.rationale: Both Krookodile (237 Speed via Choice Scarf) and Aerodactyl (200 Speed) outspeed Floette-Mega (max 154) and Basculegion (max 130). Basculegion's Aqua Jet (+1 priority) at -1 Attack cannot KO 77% HP Krookodile or full HP Focus Sash Aerodactyl. 100% accurate Knock Off into Basculegion combined with Aerodactyl's Rock Slide cleanly KOs both remaining opposing active Pokémon to win the turn, game, and series.
Floette 4% dies to any hit; Protect it. Scarf Krook outspeeds; Aqua Jet pri KO range on 77% Krook (Adapt Water 2x) before it acts, removing Intimidate/scarf threat. Aero sash lives one hit.

Basculegion is fainted and Floette-Mega is down to 3% HP. Krookodile (Speed 237 with Choice Scarf) outspeeds Floette-Mega (max Speed 154) and KOes it with 100% accurate Knock Off (11-26% damage), securing a 2-0 series victory. Even if Floette attempts consecutive Protect, it has a high chance of failure.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Basc dead; Floette 4%. Scarf Krook and Aero both outspeed and any contact OHKOs. Attacking never resolves. Only Protect (even at reduced odds) can survive the turn; then reassess. Moonblast would KO Krook if it moved.

reflections.summary: Scarf Krookodile and Aerodactyl overwhelmed the opponent's fast, fragile core (Maushold, Scarf Dragapult, Basculegion, Mega Floette) with fast spread damage and KO pressure before their offense could establish momentum.
reflections.adjustment: In similar hyper-offense matchups, maintain the Krookodile + Aerodactyl offensive lead to deny setup, while keeping Dragonite in back to comfortably absorb priority Aqua Jets.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Core Facts: Scarf Dragapult (Infiltrator), Adaptability Basculegion (Sitrus Berry, Aqua Jet/Wave Crash/Last Respects), Mega Floette (Fairy Aura, Light of Ruin), Maushold (Wide Lens, Follow Me). Strategic Plan: Fast Krookodile + Aerodactyl spread/single-target pressure completely dismantles their speed tiers and fragile team.

reflections.summary: Lost due to flawed team-preview: Floette-Mega + Maushold/Dragapult/Basculegion failed vs Gengar-Mega + Aero Tailwind/RS pressure (recoil/chip + flinch), enabling Scarf Krook cleanup; piloting clean.
reflections.adjustment: Change the four and delay/skip Floette mega—bring Ghost/Fighting + redirect to delete Gengar first, then Multiscale chip for Basc LR snowball.
